χωρίς
adv.,
__1. separately, apart: Jhn.20:7.
__2. As prep., with genitive,
__(a) separate from, apart from, without (practically equiv. to ἄνευ; see Field, Notes, 103): Mat.13:34, Mrk.4:34, Luk.6:49, Jhn.1:3 15:5, Rom.3:21, 28 4:6 7:8-9 10:14, 1Co.4:8 11:11, 2Co.12:3, Eph.2:12, Php.2:14, 1Ti.2:8 5:21, Phm 14, Heb.4:15 7:7, 20 9:7, 18 9:22, 28 10:25 11:6, 40 12:8, 14 (οὗ χωρίς; see Bl., § 82, 3), Jas.2:18, 20 2:26;
__(b) besides: Mat.14:21 15:38, 2Co.11:28.†

strongs.def: at a space, i.e. separately or apart from (often as preposition)
